## Selective Re-Research Decision
Decision: INVESTIGATE
Selected finding: Productivity gains can impede learning in dynamic environments (NBER W31161 caveat)
Research question: In fast-changing product domains, what refresh cadence and evaluation design prevent GenAI assistants from propagating outdated “best practices” while preserving their novice-boosting benefits?
Why it matters: It targets when individual AI use flips from organization-wide value to coordination/learning harm—highly actionable for teams in volatile markets that can’t stand up large transformation programs.
Known limitations: Current evidence flags the risk but doesn’t quantify optimal cadences, data windows, or organizational mitigations; most studies are in relatively stable settings or vendor case reports.
